hook: Your solar calculator can run with no battery, and your finger can switch it off.
title: Your Calculator Runs On Light, Not Battery
description:
Many solar calculators have no battery at all. They run on the light hitting a small solar panel. Cover it with your finger and watch the display fade. Try it on your own calculator.

#Shorts #Technology #Science
comment_prompt: Did the display fade on yours? Yes or no

scenes.narration: Your solar calculator can run with no battery.
scenes.headline: NO BATTERY INSIDE

scenes.narration: Cover the small solar panel with your finger.
scenes.headline: COVER THE PANEL

scenes.narration: Watch the numbers start to fade.
scenes.headline: THE DISPLAY FADES

scenes.narration: Uncover it, and they come back.
scenes.headline: UNCOVER, IT RETURNS

scenes.narration: That strip is a small solar cell.
scenes.headline: A TINY SOLAR CELL

scenes.narration: It turns room light into electricity.
scenes.headline: LIGHT BECOMES POWER

scenes.narration: Even a desk lamp is enough.
scenes.headline: A LAMP WORKS

scenes.narration: So your finger can switch it off.
scenes.headline: FINGER = OFF SWITCH

scenes.narration: Try it now. Your calculator runs on light.
scenes.headline: RUNS ON LIGHT
scenes.sub: Tomorrow: blue fire on a volcano
